# U.S. Department of the Interior

> The Department of the Interior protects and manages America's natural resources, public lands, energy development, and cultural heritage while serving Native American communities.

DOI oversees major bureaus including the National Park Service, Bureau of Land Management, U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, and Bureau of Indian Affairs. The department manages federal energy policy, public lands, water resources, and trust responsibilities to American Indian nations.

## Key Topics

- National Park Service
- Bureau of Land Management
- U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service
- Bureau of Indian Affairs

- [Secretary Doug Burgum](https://www.doi.gov/secretary-doug-burgum): Biography of Secretary Doug Burgum, 55th U.S. Secretary of Interior
